name: Nagoya University
description: Nagoya University is a national research university in Nagoya, founded in 1939 as the last of Japan's imperial universities. It runs English-taught Global 30 (G30) undergraduate and graduate programmes.
whyIncluded: Nagoya University launched a Singapore alumni branch of about 120 members in September 2025, and about 80 NUS students are expected to study in Nagoya yearly.

livingCosts.summary: Nagoya University's own estimated monthly budget for an off-campus apartment in Nagoya: rent, utilities, food, phone and personal spending, 12 months a year, without health insurance. Nagoya gives no transport figure, so that is the national survey average for the Chubu region.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. Nagoya University 'Living costs' admissions page, 'Monthly living expenses' estimate (undated, read 2026-10-08; page says 'for reference only'): housing = off-campus apartment 30,000-50,000 (midpoint 40,000) + utilities 10,000 = 50,000 (university accommodation is 42,000 including utilities); food 30,000; personal = telecommunications 5,000 + other personal expenses 10,000 = 15,000 (the page's insurance 1,500, National Health Insurance, is excluded). The page's own total is 86,500-106,500. Nagoya lists no commuting/transport line, so transport = JASSO Lifestyle Survey of Privately Financed International Students, Chubu region average commuting cost 3,000/month (table 7-4 of the FY2021 report, studyinjapan.go.jp/ja/_mt/2023/12/Seikatsu2021.pdf; the FY2023 report's regional breakdown table could not be read in this session, only its regional housing average, Chubu 30,000, which is consistent with Nagoya's rent range). Tuition (535,800/yr) excluded. Bug fix 2026-10-14: health insurance taken out of the personal line, as the schema keeps insurance out of living costs.

programmes.name: School of Engineering, G30 Automotive Engineering Program (Mechanical Engineering)
programmes.summary: Standard national-university tuition, the same for all students. The one-off ¥282,000 is the admission fee, paid once in year 1. Fees may be revised during your studies. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: English-taught Global 30 (G30) programme, listed on the G30 admissions statistics page. An Electrical, Electronic and Information Engineering track is also offered. G30 'Tuition' page: tuition ¥535,800 per academic year regardless of nationality (the same as for Japanese students); non-refundable registration fee ¥282,000 at admission; application fee (¥10,000 undergraduate / ¥20,000 graduate) excluded. The page gives no year; national-university fees may be revised during enrolment, so not cohort-locked. 2024 and 2025 rows (2026-10-13, unofficial): JPSS (Japan Study Support) Nagoya University Law page states admission fee 282,000 yen and tuition 535,800 yen 'for the 2024 school year', and its Engineering page states the same 'for the 2025 school year' (university-wide national rate).
